text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 58 · 黄铜机械观星钟楼.
Environment:  Interior of a bright clock-tower observatory, monumental translucent clock face without numerals admitting soft daylight, elegant brass gear train along one side, a small telescope on a cream stone platform, warm timber floor and curved windows opening to pale clouds. No people, faces, statues or robots. Airy precise craftsmanship, cream and warm brown with soft brass, original steampunk fantasy.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Produce a flat CAD-style 2D concept floor/site plan for the reference location. This is a diagram, NOT an illustration or isometric rendering. Camera perpendicular 90 degrees to ground; ALL furniture/structures horizontal footprint symbols only. ABSOLUTELY NO VERTICAL SURFACES OR SCENERY OR OBJECT FRONTS. Black filled wall strips, three thin parallel window lines, door quarter-circle arcs, furniture simple top-down rectangles/circles, stairs parallel lines with UP arrow. White background, flat pale zone colors. No lighting, shadows, depth, photographic textures or fake dimensions. Clearly label zones and access; infer unseen boundaries conservatively as dashed lines. Preserve exact major structure/door/window/furniture layout. Outdoors use paths, terrain contours, tree circles and water polygons. No people/animals. Title CONCEPT PLAN. Same scene: 多题材场景60组 · 58 · 黄铜机械观星钟楼
